text:
emma: Quick PR to add a tiny OptKit example showing micro-batching + kv-prefetch + a short note about choosing quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012
ryan: nice. can we include both a Python snippet and a one-line CLI that people can run locally? keeps support load down.
olga: also suggest we avoid prescribing one quant; instead add a short guideline: 'q3_k recommended for seq<64; q4_0 if memory is constrained.'
emma: added python snippet (8 lines) + single-line CLI. kept quant wording advisory.
pat: docs lint flagged code fence language missing and a broken anchor to kv-prefetch in older builds.
emma: fixed fences to "python" and updated the link to /docs/sdk/reference/kv-prefetch with a parenthetical about redirects.
docs-bot: preview-build: success  https://deploy-preview-5012--docs.redwood.ai
ryan: tiny wording tweak: change "use batching to save cost" -> "use micro-batching to reduce per-token cost while watching tail latency".
emma: updated and merged. will watch feedback for questions about q3_k vs q4_0. thanks!
